scope: Real native SceneView mouse press, planar drag and one fast Shift mouse jump. No Event coordinate mutation, no physical mouse claim. LIMITED means an explicitly explained no-motion constraint, not usability acceptance.
baselineSourceAudit: HeightDrag requests the full target from its original mouse/Y anchor. SetDrawHeight rejects a whole too-steep target and preserves the prior candidate; it does not partially advance to the feasible boundary. Before a new >=0.5m stroke it only updates message. The baseline continuing SceneView overlay can prefer Shift-height text over that prerequisite message; runtime branch flags are recorded, not presented as rendered-text capture.
